checks.reason: Card says what will go out and when: its own text to Jordan within a minute of Do it, in its own words.
Two lines saying it will send within a minute after Do it and what the text asks.
Uses the new running shoes detail from Jordan's history, but 'yesterday's run' doesn't match the step log's rest day on Sunday.
Arrives as ZOH's own curious question about the shoes, tied to his runs, with no mention of Yanni or the team.

conversation.reason: Card and console line both say ZOH will text within a minute after Do it, never that it's already sent.
Text goes out right after Do it as a warm shoe question with no run or proof push, but ends with two question forms.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression well: its console draft and confirmation promised a text within a minute of Do it, and the text that went out was a warm, grounded shoe check-in with no push about today's run and no mention of the team. The only soft spots are the 'yesterday's run' detail, which doesn't match the step log, and a follow-up that stacks two questions.
